block-guide:
CORE/POST-TEMPLATE The look of ONE post in a list; it repeats for every result. It only works as a direct child of core/query. Read the core/query guide for the whole list.
MARKUP (comments only: it has no HTML of its own) <!-- wp:post-template {"layout":{"type":"grid","columnCount":3}} --> <!-- wp:post-title {"level":3,"isLink":true} /--> <!-- wp:post-date {"metadata":{"bindings":{"datetime":{"source":"core/post-data","args":{"field":"date"}}}},"fontSize":"small"} /--> <!-- wp:post-excerpt {"excerptLength":20} /--> <!-- /wp:post-template --> Inside: post-title, post-date, post-excerpt, post-featured-image, post-terms, post-author-name, read-more, or groups and columns holding them.
LAYOUT {"type":"default"} = a list; {"type":"grid","columnCount":3} = cards in columns (one column on phones). style.spacing.blockGap sets the space between posts.
